text: Lovely concept. But after all my time and effort inputting chores and info. The chores were assigned and I can’t make adjustments to balance among my children’s profiles. Thanks for making me seem like a cruel mom lol. Had to tell my children not to install the app. Hopefully you guys can figure out how parents can manually adjust chores after they’ve been assigned. Guess it’s back to pen and paper messages on the fridge
